js: 'No sideways scrollbars in the app window, in both engines with html.tauri set (its classic scrollbars show a bar for any overflow): an agent\'s Definition manifest editor wraps its long description lines and is as tall as its wrapped text (nothing clipped, also after a 3000-character line is typed into it and taken out again, never saved; each check waits until the editor has read the same for 5 animation frames, as it is fitted on frames and Broadway WebKit draws an idle page seldom), the Devices card on /usage/keys and every Settings category fit their pane (the keys table gives up its Spend vs budget column where its card is under 800px, and then fits its card too: 720 and 819 px, with the column hidden, and 2560 px with it shown), and a status chip that carries a sentence (the device listener\'s or a WebRTC group\'s error) wraps inside its row. The agents are folder-chat, mail-labeler and docs-librarian (an instance without one fails its expects). Read-only. Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/hbars.json --block-writes --dsf 1.25 --token-file <dir>.token --base http://<addr>, or scripts/webkit-check.py --backend broadway --zoom 1.25 --timeout 1500 --drive scripts/drive/hbars.json --token-file <dir>.token --base http://<addr>.'
